content_sections.heading: About NADA Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: The National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) is an autonomous body of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, located at the Jawahar Lal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi. According to the vacancy circular, NADA is responsible for promoting, coordinating and monitoring the doping control programme in sports in all its forms across the country. The Administrative Assistant post is filled under the agency's Recruitment Rules for this post.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent in the prescribed format through proper channel, that is, forwarded by the applicant's present employer. The circular dated 14 November 2026 asks applicants to send it to this address: Director General, NADA, Hall No 103, JLN Stadium, New Delhi – 110003

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: NADA has one post of Administrative Assistant, Level 06 in the Pay Matrix (Rs 35,400– 1,12,400/-, as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix). The Recruitment Rules show the number of posts as "01 (2022)", subject to variation dependent on workload, and the classification as "Not applicable". Deputation (including short term contract)/Absorption/Re-employment (for short term contract), as given in the Recruitment Rules. Officers of the Central/States/UTs Government/PSUs/Autonomous/Statutory Bodies/Universities/Recognized Research Institutes who meet both (a) and (b): (a) (i) holding an analogous post on regular basis, or (ii) with 06 years regular service in the post in Level 5 of the Pay Matrix; and (b) (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university/institution; (b) (ii) having 05 years' experience in the Central/State Government; (b) (iii) Proficiency in Computer applications. A departmental candidate in the feeder grade is also eligible to be considered along with the outsiders; if selected, the appointment shall be deemed to have been made by promotion. The candidate should be below 56 years of age as on the closing date of the application. The Recruitment Rules (Note 2) state that the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of applications. Pay: Level 06 in the Pay Matrix, Rs 35,400– 1,12,400/-. The terms of deputation, including pay and allowances, are governed by the Department of Personnel & Training Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010 and other orders/guidelines issued from time to time. The period of deputation shall be 5 years. The lending department may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its own policy/Rules, which should not be less than three years in any case. The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another organisation/department of the Central Government, shall not ordinarily exceed 5 years. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification and the NADA website.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copy of the application in the prescribed proforma. Cadre Clearance Certificate from the Controlling Authority. Statement giving details of Major/Minor penalties imposed upon the officer, if any, during the last ten (10) years. Vigilance Clearance/Integrity Certificate. Photocopies of the ACRs/APARs for the last five (5) years, duly attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent. Verification and certification by the cadre controlling authority, while forwarding the application, that the particulars furnished by the applicant are correct.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, and incomplete applications, shall not be entertained. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. NADA reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the vacancies or to withdraw the circular at any time without assigning any reasons. The circular is addressed to all Ministries/Departments of the Government of India and all State Governments and Union Territory Administrations, with a request to publicise the vacancy in their offices. Contact printed on the circular: Accounts-cum-Administrative Officer, NADA, Tele: 011-24368274.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Administrative Assistant at the National Anti Doping Agency, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NADA Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application must be sent within 60 days from the date of issue of the advertisement in the Employment News/Rozgar Samachar; applications received after the last date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NADA Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university/institution, 05 years' experience in the Central/State Government and proficiency in computer applications, along with holding an analogous post on regular basis or 06 years regular service in Level 5 of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NADA Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The candidate should be below 56 years of age as on the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NADA Administrative Assistant?
faq.answer: The post is in Level 06 of the Pay Matrix, Rs 35,400– 1,12,400/-, with deputation terms governed by DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NADA Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format through proper channel to the Director General, NADA, Hall No 103, JLN Stadium, New Delhi – 110003, with the cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, penalty statement and attested ACRs/APARs for five years.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply for NADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only officers of the Central/States/UTs Government, PSUs, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, Universities and Recognized Research Institutes who meet the eligibility conditions; a departmental candidate in the feeder grade may also be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period at NADA?
faq.answer: The period of deputation is 5 years; the lending department may relieve an officer for a lesser period, which should not be less than three years.

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The cover should be superscribed "Application for the position of Administrative Assistant".

faq.question: Q10. Can I withdraw my application after applying?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
